title: GMV
question: 上月各大区成交额从高到低排一下
sql:
SELECT
  r.region_name AS region,
  ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount), 2) AS gmv
FROM orders AS o
JOIN regions AS r
  ON o.region_id = r.region_id
WHERE
  o.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY
  r.region_name
ORDER BY
  gmv DESC,
  region
LIMIT 1000
